==Description==
'''Beach Ball''' is an emote that could be obtained at level 39 of the premium [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]]. It was made by fybirr. The emote is looped and moveable, but not interactable. No music can be heard while performing this emote.

When performed, the player will begin to move on a giant beach ball. This makes the player move slower, but makes them capable of jumping far higher than before. Additionally, while, moving, they will be unable to stop walking in a direction immediately due to them being on the ball. The ball will slowly drift after the player stops moving, gradually getting slower before coming to a halt.

It has a cost of {{BeachBalls|1,410}} or {{Robux|132}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{BeachBalls|25,630}} or {{Robux|3,639}}. This item also has had two other costs. First one was the cost before its 20% discount, which had a cost of {{Robux|166}} with a total cost of {{Robux|4,570}}. The second was the price prior to the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] individual skip cost fix, where it had a cost of {{Robux|108}}, with a total cost of {{Robux|3,430}}.
